nodes.name: Chai-Spiced Apple Oat Pancakes
nodes.assembly_instructions: 1. Preheat flat-top griddle to 350 F. 2. In bowl, combine all ingredients. Add pancake mix. Whisk until just blended. Batter will be slightly lumpy. DO NOT OVERMIX. 3. Coat hot griddle with cooking spray. 4. On griddle, pour 2-oz ladles batter 3" apart. 5. Cook until top of pancakes are covered with bubbles and edges begin to dry, 1 to 2 minutes. Turn pancakes over. Cook until golden brown, 1 to 2 minutes. 6. Serve immediately or use as directed in recipe.

nodes.name: Buffalo Chicken Grilled Cheese
nodes.assembly_instructions: FOR 1 SERVING: 1. Layer the following on 1 slice of bread: 1 slice cheese 1 tbl Buffalo Blue Dressing 2-oz spoodle Chicken 1 slice cheese 2nd slice of bread 2. Brush outside of sandwich with 1 tbl margarine. PANINI PRESS METHOD 1. Preheat panini press to 400 F. 2. Place sandwich in panini press. Cook until sandwich is browned and cheese begins to melt, 3 to 4 minutes. Cheese does not have to melt completely. 3. Cut diagonally in half. 4. Cover. Keep hot for service. FLAT-TOP GRIDDLE METHOD 1. Preheat flat-top griddle to 350 F. 2. Cook sandwich, turning once, until browned and cheese is melted, 2 to 3 minutes on each side. 3. Cut diagonally in half. 4. Cover. Keep hot for service.

nodes.name: Crispy Chicken BBQ Snacker
nodes.assembly_instructions: 1. Preheat deep-fat fryer to 350 F. 2. Fry frozen chicken patties until golden brown and internal temperature reaches 165 F, 4 to 6 minutes. Drain. 3. Cut each patty into 3 strips. FOR 1 SERVING: 1. Layer the following in center of 1 tortilla: 2 tsp sauce 1-oz spoodle lettuce 1 piece onion, separated into rings 1 piece chicken 1 slice cheese Fold bottom of tortilla up over filling, about 1". Fold in right and left edges of tortilla 2" on each side to form a V. Top 1/3 of filling should be exposed. 2. Keep hot for service.
nodes.special_instructions: Place fryer basket on sheet pan to fill. DO NOT fill basket over fryer. DO NOT fill fryer basket more than 1/3 full.

nodes.name: California Turkey Bacon Wrap

Layer the following over lower two-thirds of tortilla: 2 slices tomato 2 slices avocado 2-oz spoodle lettuce 1 1/2 ozw turkey 1 slice Turkey Bacon Fold lower third of tortilla up over filling. Fold in right and left edges of tortilla about 1" on each side. Roll wrap closed. Place seam side down. 3. Cut diagonally in half. 4. Cover. Keep chilled for service.

nodes.name: Apple Cinnamon Pancake
nodes.assembly_instructions: 1. Combine flour, sugar, brown sugar, baking powder, ground cinnamon, and salt. Whisk until well blended. 2. Combine milk, sliced apple, egg, margarine and lemon juice. Whisk until well blended. 3. Preheat flat-top griddle to 350 F. 4. Add dry ingredients all at once to wet ingredients. Whisk until just blended. Batter will be slightly lumpy. DO NOT OVERMIX. 5. Coat hot griddle with cooking spray. 6. On griddle, pour 2-oz ladles batter 3" apart 7. Cook until top of pancakes are covered with bubbles and edges begin to dry, 2 to 3 minutes. 8. Turn pancakes over. Cook until golden brown, 2 to 3 minutes. 9. Cover. Keep hot for service or use as directed in recipe.

nodes.name: Creamy Tomato Basil Soup
nodes.assembly_instructions: 1. In stockpot over medium-high heat, heat oil. Add onion, celery and carrot. Saute until vegetables are tender, 4 to 6 minutes. Stir in tomato paste and base. 2. Add remaining ingredients except half & half and basil. Whisk until well blended. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Simmer 35 minutes. Discard bay leaves. Puree. 3. Heat half & half to 140 F. 4. Return pureed mixture to pot. Stir in heated half & half. Return to a simmer. DO NOT BOIL. 5. Cover. Keep hot for service. 6. At time of service, stir in basil.
